# QualityKit

> Open-source SEO + AEO MCP server for Next.js codebases. Audits defects vs opportunities, scores AI readiness, and proposes advise-only fixes. Free forever for local use; Pro adds hosted monitoring.

## Product
- Name: QualityKit
- Site: https://qualitykit.dev
- Docs: https://qualitykit.dev/docs/
- Pricing: https://qualitykit.dev/pricing/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qualitykit
- GitHub: https://github.com/maxim-at-autonomiclabs/qualitykit

## Important
- Local MCP audits and fixes never require a QualityKit account.
- The coding agent applies approved diffs; QualityKit does not write your repo.
- Model tokens come from the user's agent/provider, not QualityKit.
- Scores and findings are heuristics — not ranking or citation guarantees.

## Optional Pro
- Hosted daily crawls, history, and email regression alerts for one production site ($29/mo).
